lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg6Sc2 (reduced formula Mg3Sc) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/amd (No. 143), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies both Mg and Sc centers as 12-coordinate, each with a close-packed-like local arrangement and neighbor distances near 3.02–3.22 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, as well as edge- and face-sharing between Mg- and Sc-centered polyhedra.
